response.text:
I can do that, but publishing/overwriting a shared document is a destructive action so I need a few details and an explicit confirmation before I proceed.

Please tell me:
1. Which document exactly (file name and path or link to the shared original).  
2. Where is the edited policy document (attach it here, paste it, or give the draft location/link).  
3. Do you want me to create a backup/version of the current original before overwriting? (yes/no — and if yes, any naming convention)  
4. Who should be notified when it’s published (everyone in the shared folder, a specific mailing list, or particular people)?  
5. Any additional actions after publish (send an announcement, add change-log entry, set edit permissions)?

If you want me to proceed after you provide the above, please confirm with a clear explicit confirmation such as:
"Confirm: Overwrite [document path or link] with the attached edited policy, create backup named [backup name], and notify [recipients]."

I will not make any changes until I receive the document/location and that explicit confirmation. I can also produce a preview/diff or a short publish message for you to send. Which would you like?
